server-app.identity.claudeOnly: Only Claude Code sessions can switch identity for now
server-app.identity.fresh: The conversation record of the old identity was given up: from the next message on, the new identity starts a new native conversation. The history shown here is all still here, but the AI no longer remembers it.
server-app.identity.liveBusy: The AI process is still running (this turn, background tasks or timers): wait for them to end, or take it offline first, then switch identity

server-app.identity.sameNode: You can only switch to an identity on the same execution node
server-app.identity.switched: The identity was switched from “{from}” to “{to}”. From the next message on this conversation continues as the new identity (the history is all here); the model chosen for this session was cleared, the new identity's model is used.
server-app.identity.terminalOpen: The native CLI terminal is still open and uses this identity's folder: close the terminal before switching identity
server-app.identity.turnRunning: This turn has not finished; switch identity once it has
server-app.job.approvalIdUsed: The approval ID is already used
server-app.job.noSidecarSupport: The execution node's Runner does not support ask-only side threads; not run

server-app.job.recoveryMismatch: The recovery credential does not match the original run
server-app.job.recoveryOutOfScope: A recovered event is outside the original session
server-app.login.acpNoManaged: {name} does not support an identity with its own login (its CLI directory cannot be set apart, or it cannot log in here); make the identity with the CLI already logged in on this machine: {command} profile create --agent {agent} --auth-mode subscription. {hint}
server-app.login.needsManaged: Add an identity with its own login; the host's own credentials are never changed
server-app.login.noInput: This login flow is not taking an authorization code now
server-app.login.nodeRevoked: The execution node is revoked; you cannot log in on it
server-app.login.profileBusy: Stop this identity's running tasks first
server-app.login.tooMany: Finish or cancel the login flows already open
server-app.node.unknown: The execution node does not exist or is revoked
server-app.pin.setLocalOnly: The PIN was reset on this machine: it can be set again only in this machine's terminal ({command} pin set)

server-app.profile.baseUrlInvalid: The service address must be an HTTP(S) URL
server-app.profile.busyDelete: This identity still has running tasks; stop them before deleting it
server-app.profile.modelSlotsClaudeOnly: Model slots are for Claude Code identities only

server-app.profile.switchedProcessRunnin: A session has just switched to another identity and the old identity's AI process has not ended yet; delete it later

server-app.queue.appendExpiredKept: This addition was not read in the turn of {at}; it expired and was not sent again (the external callback is kept and arrives with the next turn)
server-app.queue.cancelledBeforeRun: The task was cancelled before it ran
